cases.prompt: 使用 ui-design 为 Lumen 发票工具设计 Tailwind CSS v4 Design Token。品牌色 #0f766e。Tailwind 入口文件是 existing-system/theme.css，基础组件目录是 existing-system/。在该入口里补齐任务需要的语义角色和明暗主题，保留现有变量名与颜色写法。不要新建平行的 design-tokens.json、替换主题或新增组件文件。说明已运行与未运行的验收。
checks: Brief records product goal, hierarchy, main action, and the token roles this entry must carry
Named Tailwind entry and component directory are read before editing
Semantic roles are written into existing-system/theme.css
Existing variable names, color format, and brand survive
No parallel design-tokens.json, replacement theme, or new component files
Source evidence and unverified checks are stated separately

cases.prompt: 使用 ui-design 调整 existing-system/ 里的 Button，使它的颜色和状态使用 existing-system/theme.css 中的语义角色。Tailwind 入口文件是 existing-system/theme.css，基础组件目录是 existing-system/。保留 Button 的现有 props。不重新建立主题，不安装依赖，不新建组件文件。说明已运行与未运行的验收。
checks: Existing theme.css and button.tsx are inspected before choosing values
Existing CSS variables, Button props, and brand survive
Button colors and states use the entry's semantic roles
No parallel design-tokens.json, replacement theme, dependency installation, or new component files
Existing-system evidence and unverified checks are stated honestly
